app.name: Speaking Easy with Practise
app.tagline: Daily IELTS and CEFR speaking practice

common.comingSoonText: This part is being built and will appear here soon.

landing.title: Practise speaking every day
landing.lead: Questions are read aloud, you answer by voice, and your recordings stay on your own device. Build a daily streak with 15 minutes of practice.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Use your Google account to continue.
login.error: Sign-in did not work. Please try again.

onboarding.title: Welcome!
onboarding.lead: Tell us who you are so your teacher can see your progress.
onboarding.errorName: Please enter your full name (at least 2 letters).
onboarding.errorSave: Could not save. Please try again.

home.streak: {count, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language of the website.
settings.deleteLead: This deletes your account, streak and practice history for good. Recordings on this device stay where they are.
settings.deleteConfirmText: Your account, streak and practice history will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmCheck: I understand that this cannot be undone
settings.deleteError: Could not delete the account. Please try again.
settings.ownerNote: The owner account cannot be deleted from the app.

admin.title: Admin
admin.lead: Manage questions, topics and mock tests.
admin.comingNext: Students list and weekly reports come in Step 5.

content.title: Topics and questions
content.notLinked: Not linked to a cue card

topic.title: Title
topic.usedInMocks: {count, plural, =0 {Not used in any mock set} one {Used in # mock set} other {Used in # mock sets}}

question.noSpeech: This browser cannot read text aloud.

add.title: Add questions
add.lead: Choose a topic, then add one question or paste many (one per line).
add.skipNote: Questions already in this topic are skipped. Similar ones are only a warning.
add.added: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new was added.} one {# question added.} other {# questions added.}}
add.notCueCard: Part 2 cue cards have bullet points instead of questions. Edit them on the topic page.

io.title: Import and export
io.exportLead: Download all topics, questions and mock sets as one JSON file. Keep it somewhere safe as a backup.
io.importLead: Use a file in the same format. Nothing is deleted: new items are added and existing ones are updated.
io.previewNote: This is a preview. Nothing has been saved yet.
io.wrongFormat: This file is not in the speaking-easy-content/v2 format.

errors.duplicateTitle: A topic with this title already exists in this part.

owner.title: Owner
owner.lead: Give or remove the admin role here.

practice.chooseParts: What do you want to practise?

optionHelp.p1: Short questions about you and familiar topics
optionHelp.p2: One cue card: 1 minute to prepare, up to 2 minutes to speak
optionHelp.p1p3: Part 1 first, then Part 3, like the real exam

practice.recordingLead: Recordings stay only on this device. They are never uploaded.

check.title: Microphone check
check.speak: Say something. The bar should move.
check.denied: Permission was denied. Allow the microphone (and camera) for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
check.notFound: No microphone or camera was found on this device.
check.unsupported: This browser cannot record. Try the latest Chrome or Safari, or choose “No recording”.

practice.empty: There are no questions for this choice yet.
practice.safariNote: On iPhone, keep the screen on and stay on this page while you practise.
practice.voiceNote: Questions are read by your device's voice. Turn the sound on.

session.question: Question {n} of {total}
session.prepHelp: You have 1 minute to think. You can make notes.
session.paused: Paused while the page is hidden
session.leaveWarning: Your session is still running. Leave anyway?
session.quitMockConfirm: End the mock test now? It will not count as done.

finish.title: Well done!
finish.notSaved: Could not save your practice time. Check your internet connection.
finish.deviceOnly: This recording is only on this device. Download it if you want to keep it. Old recordings are deleted automatically when there are more than 10.
finish.recordingFailed: The recording could not be saved on this device.

mock.none: There are no mock tests for this exam yet. They will be added soon.
mock.p1: Questions about you, about {s} seconds each
mock.p2: Cue card: {prep} min to prepare, up to {speak} min to speak
mock.rules: Like the real exam: questions move on by themselves when the time is up, and you cannot replay them. A mock test only counts as done when you finish all three parts.
mock.taken: This mock test is already done. The next one has been loaded.
mock.broken: This mock test is not ready yet. Please tell your teacher.
mock.doneNote: {name} is done. You will get a different mock test next time.
mock.stoppedNote: You stopped before the end, so this mock test does not count as done. It can come again later.

progress.title: My progress
progress.goalLeft: {minutes, plural, one {# more minute} other {# more minutes}} to count today.
progress.rule: A day counts after 15 minutes of practice in total (Tashkent time). Missing a day starts the streak again from 0.
progress.noSessions: No sessions yet. Start with General Training or a Mock Test.

recordings.title: My recordings
recordings.warning: Recordings are kept only on this device, in this browser. They are never uploaded. Download the ones you want to keep: if you clear the browser or change phones, they are gone. Only the newest 10 are kept.
recordings.empty: No recordings on this device yet.
recordings.emptyHelp: Choose Audio or Video before a practice session to record yourself.
recordings.unavailable: This browser cannot keep recordings. Try the latest Chrome or Safari.
recordings.deleteConfirm: Delete this recording? This cannot be undone.
